messages:
alex: Starting release window now for release 2026.3 — rolling in stages (canary -> staggered -> full). Please verify artifact pin and ack the rollback/runbook links below. I want a thumbs from owners before canary progresses.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started to 10 hosts in us-west-2 · Canary ID: canary-2026-03 · monitor: https://deploy.redwood.internal/deploys/3087654321
maria: Ack, pin verified. Artifact tag: r2026.3-20260320-8a2f. Who owns rollback if we see sustained latency?
sam: I own rollback on this one — criteria I'm using: P95 > 300ms sustained 2m OR error-rate > 1% for 3m. Runbook here: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback . Quick rollback command: ```./scripts/rollback.sh --tag r2026.2-production```
vikram: Heads up — release notes PR #412 updated with the hotfix plan. We also have a hotpatch branch r2026.3-hotfix1 if we prefer patch+pin vs full rollback.
jules: Comms plan: if we rollback, notify #all-hands, PG, and send status update to customers. I'll prep a short template now. @maria can you do a PagerDuty alert test so runbook mention is verified?
maria: Running PD test now. Will annotate test in the runbook and tick off when green. Also prepping a blue/green fallback option in case canary fails fast. :white_check_mark:
alex: Add one pre-rollback checklist item — ensure migrations are not reversed automatically. Set `release.schema_lock=false` on the deployment config to avoid migration rollback loops. Watch the migrations job in the UI.
engops-bot: Reminder: change window 20:00-22:00 UTC. Auto-rollback flag is armed. To disable auto-rollback: `deployctl set-flag auto_rollback false`
sam: Copying the runbook excerpt into channel for quick reference: "If rollback triggered: 1) pin previous stable tag r2026.2-production; 2) run edge cache purge: `edgectl purge --all`; 3) disable autoscaler for 5 min; 4) send status update via status.redwood.ai; 5) attach logs to runbook"
alex: Final ack from me, moving to canary watch. If you see anomalies ping @sam and @jules immediately. I'll update the release notes with a rollback note and link to the postmortem template if we need it. :rocket:
